title: At the Hotel Desk
author: Hive
intro: 这是客人在酒店前台办理入住的对话。客人有预订，先确认身份和早餐时间，房间的灯坏了就换了一间房，最后请前台第二天一早叫出租车去机场。你可以任选前台或客人的角色朗读。
tips: 客人的请求多用 Could you、Is it possible，语调要柔和。
seven、quarter to seven 这类时间要读清楚。

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: Good evening, and welcome to our hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: Yes, I do. The reservation is under the name Lee, for two nights, starting tonight.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Lee. Could I see your passport, please? Your room is on the fifth floor.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: Here you go. Is breakfast included in the price? I'd like to know what time it starts.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: Yes, breakfast is included. It's served in the restaurant on the ground floor, from seven to ten.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: Great, thank you. Oh, there's one problem. The bathroom light in my room doesn't work.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: I'm sorry about that. Let me send someone up to fix it right away.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: Thank you. Is it possible to have a different room, if the repair takes too long?

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: Of course. Here is a new key for room 618, on the sixth floor. It has a bigger desk.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: That's perfect, thank you so much. Could you order a taxi to the airport for seven tomorrow morning?

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: Sure. What time is your flight, so I can tell the driver when to arrive?

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: The flight leaves at nine, so the taxi should come at a quarter to seven.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: No problem. I'll book it now, and the taxi will wait for you outside the main entrance.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: Thank you for your help. I hope I can enjoy my stay here.

segments.speaker: Receptionist
segments.text: You're welcome. Enjoy your stay, and have a good night's sleep.
